Report to General Zong: 
     Since your departure, we have slept with our Blades at hand, never slacking. However, few travelers enter Qinchuan from Liangzhou, and we have found no trace of the golden peach bearer on this ancient road. 
     Deputy General Zhu and his forces have not responded, cutting off our supplies. We agreed to support each other—our brothers guard this desolate grassland entrance to Qinchuan, while his forces hold the fortress leading to Chang'an, sharing resources. Now it seems all lies—he seeks only his own comfort, waiting to reap the rewards! While we endure hardship, you labor tirelessly—this is grossly unfair! Is this not the Dragon Guard's great misfortune? The men eagerly await your return to set things right. 
     The critical supplies you ordered us to prepare are ready—awaiting only your command—
